patch:
diff --git a/src/click/probe_without_help.py b/src/click/probe_without_help.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0a7a4d6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/probe_without_help.py
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Command
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Option
+
+
+class ProbeWithoutHelp(Command):
+    def get_help_option(self, ctx: Context) -> Option | None:
+        """Returns the help option object.
+
+        Skipped if :attr:`add_help_option` is ``False`` or during resilient
+        parsing.
+
+        .. versionchanged:: 8.1.8
+            The help option is now cached to avoid creating it multiple times.
+        """
+        if ctx.resilient_parsing:
+            return None
+
+        return super().get_help_option(ctx)
notes:
Added src/click/probe_without_help.py with ProbeWithoutHelp(Command); its get_help_option returns None immediately when ctx.resilient_parsing is true, then delegates to super().get_help_option(ctx), preserving the base caching/behavior, signature, and the super() parent-call target. No existing modules were modified.
Agent-reported tests_run (not independently verified): "pip install -e . && python -m pytest tests -q: 900 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed; plus a manual sanity script asserting resilient_parsing short-circuits to None, help option is created/cached otherwise, and add_help_option=False returns None \u2014 all passed."
